correctness.rationale: PASS. Express richness as S minus species-absence indicators; their pairwise joint absence probabilities follow by two-stage hypergeometric selection for all m,n. For m=n=2, collision indicators H_A=2-K_A and H_B=2-K_B reduce covariance to counting ordered disjoint same-species pairs; identity (a)_2²-(a)_4=4(a)_3+2(a)_2 gives [((4N-6)/(N(N-1)))T2²-4T3-2T2]/(N)_4. Substitution for d doubletons yields exact sign test, N=4 correlations +1 (2,2), -1 (3,1); sign witnesses for every N>=4. Independent exact rational enumeration checked all 60 abundance partitions N4..8 and 580 admissible general sampling cases N<=7; symbolic counting proof establishes all finite N.
residual_risks: This is fixed-census, disjoint simple random sampling, not iid draws or ecological spatial quadrats.
